title: things i noticed on a walk
body:
a big white flower with a red center

a window ac unit

a pole that i once climbed, that i can now touch the top of 

the house numbers, why do they start in the ten thousands on such a short street?

a young, growing tree with a sign "provides shade", natural manifestation!

a robin foraging in the grass and eating a worm

a sign that says no peeing here, dogs can't read

a weather aged gnome

a caterpillar dangling 10 feet from a tree and 10 feet from the ground

a bike toppled in a yard, the way i would when visiting friends

a mailbox with the number 222

8/11/26 3:55pm
